name: @w6w-apps/metabase
description: Run saved Metabase questions and ad-hoc MBQL/SQL queries, export results as CSV/JSON/XLSX, and browse collections, dashboards, databases and search.

w6w.longDescription:
Metabase is a BI tool people point at a database to build questions, save them into collections and pin them onto dashboards — and this app's job is running a question someone already built and getting today's number out of it. Run a saved question or a dashboard card with its filters applied, or run raw SQL or MBQL directly against a connected database, and export any result as CSV, JSON or XLSX.

Beyond running numbers, list and search dashboards, collections and databases, read a dashboard's own cards, and pull a database's table and field metadata from Metabase's last sync — useful for building the rest of a workflow around real question and database ids rather than guessing at them. Create new questions and collections directly from a workflow, too.

Metabase is open source and works the same way whether it is self-hosted or running as Metabase Cloud, so this app connects to whichever instance a site actually runs, using an API key scoped to a single permissions group.
